name: sonar-console
description: Telemetry + visualization console for the adaptive sonar TX module (ESP32)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron .
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --linux
